goal:
You are a shopper in Bangalore recording exactly what this store shows a customer. Report facts only, never opinions.
Never pay, never enter card or UPI details, never create an account, never request an OTP.

1. On this product page, record the product name, the price shown, any struck-through price, every fee or charge mentioned on this page (delivery, handling, COD, platform, convenience), and any urgency text such as a countdown timer with its remaining time, 'only N left', or 'N people viewing'.
2. If the page asks for a pincode or delivery location, enter 560037. If a size or variant must be chosen, pick the first one in stock. Add exactly one unit to the cart.
3. Open the cart. List every line item and whether the shopper added it. List every option that is already selected or ticked without the shopper choosing it, such as insurance, a donation, a membership, gift wrap, a protection plan, or marketing or WhatsApp consent, with its price. Copy the exact wording of any button or link used to decline an add-on.
4. Continue to checkout as a guest. If it asks for details, use name "Audit Shopper", email "audit.shopper@example.com", phone "9000000000", address "OJone, Marathahalli, Bengaluru", pincode 560037. Stop at the first screen that asks for payment, or at any login, OTP, or captcha step.
5. List every fee line in the order summary with its amount in rupees and the first step where it appeared. Record the final payable amount.

If something is not on the page, leave it empty or null. Do not guess or calculate amounts that are not shown.
